product_metadata.title: Urban Deco Taper Candle Holders for Candlesticks Vintage Candle Holders for Table Centerpiece Decorative Tall Candle Holder Fits 3/4 Inch Brass Candlestick Holders - Black Matte - Pack of 3.
features: MINIMALIST TAPER CANDLE HOLDERS: Minimalist design of this candlestick holders combines an exquisite concept with a simple and spacious Nordic aesthetic. This tall candle holder surface is electroplated in an understated and attractive matte black, making taper candle holder ornamental and anti-corrosive while keeping an elegant, sophisticated, and textured luster with superb craftsmanship

STURDY CANDLE STICK HOLDER: These high-quality black candlestick holders are constructed of iron. Each candle sticks long holder has a solid and heavy spherical base that is hard to shake, tumble, or slide. Brass candlestick holders are available in 3 sizes to accommodate all common taper candles. Candles with a diameter of 3/4 inch and led taper candles are compatible with this rustic candle holder

EXQUISITE DETAILS OF CANDLE HOLDER SET: Under the base of these brass candle holder is a soft black flannelette pad. Reduces friction and damage by isolating the furniture from the metal of the farmhouse candle holders. The visual impact of the undulating high and low illumination creates a lovely romantic scene

EASY INSTALLATION OF CANDLESTICK HOLDER: The candle holder is designed with thread, so all you have to do is screw the rod into the bottom and lower end of the candle hole to finish the installation, which takes about 30 seconds. Wipe clean with a soft cloth after use. This rustic candle holder can be presented alone or in a variety of ways depending on your design preferences

DIMENSIONS OF TEALIGHT CANDLE HOLDER: The tea light candle holder come in three sizes: small (3.18.81 inch), medium (3.10.81 inch), and large (3.12.81 inch). This candle stick holder bundle does not contain candles. Boho candle holders of various heights put in the table's centerpiece. Suitable for Bedroom, living room, study area, dining table, and bar. The lovely fireplace candle holder is ideal for anniversaries, creating ambience, and as housewarming presents
